title: Pushing the boundaries: enhancing TiO2 performance for hydrogen evolution under visible light photocatalysis by incorporating RuO2
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE00040H, Paper
Moses D. Ashie, Gayani Pathiraja, Shobha Mantripragada, Bishnu P. Bastakoti
The careful modulation of RuO2 content in TiO2 nanostructures plays a crucial role in optimizing photochemical properties resulting in water splitting under visible light, making them promising candidates for solar-driven hydrogen generation.
